title: The Quiet Tide
author: Jude Voss
blurb: Vesper Zhou, a pastry chef whose café is three missed payments from gone, believes second chances are for people with better timing. But when a lost letter surfaces, postmarked eleven years ago, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must risk the whole heart instead of lending pieces before the vineyard's first harvest comes in.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
